name: statusline-band
description: Port of statuslineV4.sh to a mod: draws the same figures in two colored rows (dir, git, model, effort | duration, version, session id / rate limits, context, cost, output style | RAM) in the band above the prompt, so the Desktop Code tab gets a status line. Off in the terminal by default, where the real statusLine still runs.

show_in_terminal.title: Show in terminal
show_in_terminal.description: Also draw the band in terminal sessions (off by default, since the CLI already runs statuslineV4.sh)

dir_levels.title: Directory levels
dir_levels.description: Trailing path components to show; 0 shows the full path

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often git, RAM and duration refresh between turns
